title: A Healing Robe of Stones
content:
I had a major car accident. I coded three times. I had a lacerated liver, holes in my spleen and over 100 broken bones. I was life flitted from California to Reno. I remember being above my body and seeing myself wrapped in blankets.

I floated above my body and then I was by my husband’s side. He was telling some people I had a lacerated liver, they were putting ice on my liver and that I may die. I could not understand why he could not hear me. I was telling him I was ok then I seemed to fly toward the sky where I saw my father who had passed two mouths prior.

My father looked great. He had passed from cancer that left him aged; however, he looked refreshed and young again. He told me I was not finished with my work and I had to come back. I did not want to come back.

Then I was in a golden light with an old Indian man. He and I made a healing robe of stones for me to wear. It was leather with a breastplate and it was moonstone, lapis and silver. It seemed heavy on my body. I kept asking to pass over but was told no. I begged, as the pain I was to endure seemed too great. I had to stay in the golden warm light with this healing robe for three days. I was shown things that are at times blocked to me now but are remembered at the right times.

Fifteen days later I recall my first real memory of the hospital and the happenings. I was told I had been given 22 units of blood and surgeries to fix my broken bones. I had so many infections they did not expect me to live. The 22 units of blood and the 24 hours of surgeries were not expected to help. I did live and heal like a miracle from it within three days. They said my wounds healed unbelievably and it was amazing.

The strange thing about the healing robe is the origin of the stones (Atlantis as written by Edgar Casey) that are believed to help with blood and infections (just what I needed). It has taken some time to understand and be grounded here again. I have had the classic after affects of an NDE so I won't go into detail. My life is 100% different now.

diagnosis.diagnosis_raw: Major car accident; coded three times; lacerated liver, holes in spleen, over 100 broken bones; many infections; given 22 units of blood; 24 hours of surgeries to fix broken bones.
diagnosis.disease_name: Polytrauma from major motor vehicle accident with lacerated liver, splenic injury, >100 fractures, severe infections; cardiac arrest x3 (coded three times).
diagnosis.severity_description: Critical polytrauma; near-death (coded three times) with severe internal injuries and infections; not expected to live.
diagnosis.prognosis_given: They did not expect me to live; husband was told I may die; blood and surgeries were not expected to help.

treatment.treatments_raw: 22 units of blood; 24 hours of surgeries to fix broken bones; ice on liver mentioned during acute care.
treatment.surgery_type: Surgeries to fix broken bones (orthopedic repair) over ~24 hours

remission_outcome.time_to_remission_raw: Healed like a miracle within three days (wounds healed unbelievably)
remission_outcome.verification_detail: Narrator reports clinicians said wounds healed unbelievably and it was amazing; survival despite expectation of death from infections and trauma.

turner_factors.spiritual_practices_raw: Near-death experience with deceased father; presence of an 'old Indian man' in golden light; 'healing robe of stones'.
purpose_sources: unfinished work / life purpose (told she was not finished with her work)
turner_factors.purpose_details: Deceased father told her she was not finished with her work and had to come back.

pre_illness_state.loss_description: Father died two months prior to the accident (from cancer).

existential_shift.identity_shift_description: States life is 100% different now after the NDE and recovery.
existential_shift.surrender_description: She begged to 'pass over' but was told no and ultimately returned.
existential_shift.transformation_narrative: NDE led to major life change; was told she had to return because not finished with her work; reports classic aftereffects and being different afterward.
existential_shift.pivot_point_description: Encounter with deceased father who told her to come back; subsequent 'healing robe of stones' experience in golden light.
existential_shift.transformation_timing: NDE occurred during/around the time she coded; rapid physical healing described afterward (within three days).

anomalous_experience.experience_description: Out-of-body perception above her body; visited husband; then encountered deceased father who instructed her to return; then in golden light with an old Indian man creating a 'healing robe of stones' worn for three days; shown information later partially blocked.
anomalous_experience.experience_timing: During the acute phase after the car accident when she coded three times.
anomalous_experience.message_content: You are not finished with your work; you have to come back.

validation.statistical_improbability_notes: Narrative asserts survival and unusually rapid wound healing despite massive trauma, severe infections, repeated coding, and clinicians not expecting survival.
validation.extraction_notes: Case is severe trauma/infection recovery rather than cancer; remission terminology is approximate. No objective imaging/lab documentation provided; physician confirmation is indirect via reported statements.

analysis.case_summary: After a major car accident with repeated cardiac arrest, internal organ injury, >100 fractures, and severe infections, the narrator reports an NDE involving her deceased father and a symbolic 'healing robe of stones.' She later reports unexpectedly rapid healing (within ~3 days) and survival despite clinicians not expecting her to live.
key_healing_factors: Near-death experience with directive to return (sense of purpose)
Perceived healing intervention/symbol ('healing robe of stones') during NDE
Rapid recovery from severe infections/trauma described as medically surprising
unique_features: NDE included encounter with deceased father two months after his death
Extended experience of 'three days' in golden light wearing a 'healing robe of stones'
Healing symbolism explicitly linked by narrator to blood and infections
analysis.analysis_notes: This is not a spontaneous remission of cancer but an anomalously rapid recovery from polytrauma and infections following intensive conventional care. The narrative provides some quantitative medical details (22 units blood, 24 hours surgery) but lacks dates, diagnoses codes, imaging, or records.
